title: fix(app-shell): the pre-publish capability lint reads the registry's capabilities; isolated tenant-admin assignment re-verified (#7611)
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuP7eYfRU6CWMbK5okSTnHUm)_

Fixes #7611

This closes the remainder that release record 6357827416 left on #7611. All three items are done: one is a measurement with no source change, one is a cleanup with no behaviour change, and one is a fix for a lint warning that reproduced.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 1. Under `isolated`, a tenant admin still assigns through the Setup picker (measured, no change needed)

**Rig.** objectstack framework built at `main` `830a63a6`, a descendant of `448374d3f8` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24136, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24732). The app-showcase app plus `@objectstack/organizations` was booted twice with `os dev --seed-admin --fresh`:
- `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` with `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only` (port 4011). The boot banner reads `Tenancy: isolated`.
- `single` (port 4010). The boot banner reads `Tenancy: single`.

This branch's console ran against each server. Personas were minted through `/api/v1/auth/admin/create-user`, then change-password, `organization/create`, `invite-member` and `accept-invitation`. Tara Tenant owns Acme Tenant: her `/me/permissions` lists `organization_admin` and `isPlatformAdmin: false`. Mia Member and Noah Newhire are members. Playwright drove the real pages at `/apps/setup/metadata/{position|permission}/<name>?scope=environment`, clicked **Add holder** or **Add user**, and picked the user in the `RecordPickerDialog`. Every `/api` response was recorded.

**`isolated`, tenant admin Tara:**

| Step on the Setup page | Request | Answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Position `contributor`, add holder Mia | `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` `{"user_id":"fnBt…","position":"contributor"}` | **201**. The row carries `organization_id` = Acme Tenant, and Mia appears in the holders list. |
| Position `field_ops_delegate`, add holder Mia | `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` | **403** `organization administrator 'insert' on 'sys_user_position' rejected — position 'field_ops_delegate' carries permission set 'showcase_field_ops_delegate', which fails condition (b) of the organization boundary: it carries an adminScope…`. The page shows the server's sentence. |
| Permission set `showcase_contributor`, add user Noah | `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set` `{"user_id":"AE0q…","permission_set":"showcase_contributor"}` | **201** |
| Permission set `admin_full_access`, add user Noah | `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set` | **403** `permission set 'admin_full_access', which is outside the organization boundary by name…` |
| Remove Noah from `showcase_contributor` | `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set/Hl81…` | **200** |
| Remove Mia from `contributor` | `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_user_position/Qzul…` | **200** |
| Position and permission lists | none | Read-only banner, no **New** button. |

Across 393 recorded responses, none went to the retired `sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set` or `sys_capability` objects.

**`single`, unchanged:**

| Persona | Step | Answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Platform admin | Add holder to position `contributor`, add user to set `showcase_contributor` | **201**, **201**. **New** is offered, matching #12998. |
| Org admin Olga (`organization_admin_no_bypass`) | Add holder to position `manager`, add user to set `showcase_executive` | **201**, **201** |
| Org admin Olga | Add user to set `admin_full_access` | **403**, outside the organization boundary by name |
| Org admin Olga | Remove the `manager` holder | **200**. The lists show no **New** button. |

Under `single`, an org admin now assigns inside the boundary as well. That is objectstack-ai/objectstack#24136's grant, which is not specific to `isolated`, and the console follows the server's grant with no posture branch. The platform admin's path is the same as before.

## 2. Dead `sys_position` display entry removed (internal, no behaviour change)

- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/approverIdentity.ts`: removed `sys_position` from `DISPLAY_FIELDS_BY_OBJECT`. No `data` binding names it, because the installed spec binds `position` to the registry (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22710).
- The `approverValueIsName` docblock now describes the registry arm and the `data` arm as they are.
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useApproverDirectory.ts`: comment-only. Its docblock still listed a position row among the directory objects it reads.

## 3. The pre-publish capability lint read no registry capabilities (reproduced, fixed)

`@objectstack/lint`'s `validateCapabilityReferences` resolves a reference against three sources: the built-in capabilities, `stack.capabilities` (the `defineCapability` declarations) and every permission set's `systemPermissions`. `lintDraftCapabilityReferences` built a pseudo-stack with no `capabilities`. So a capability declared with `defineCapability` and granted by no set was reported as resolving nowhere on every draft that required it.

**Measured live** on the `single` rig with Publish from Home. Two object drafts were used. One requires `showcase.restricted_ops`: `GET /api/v1/meta/capability` serves it, and no permission set grants it. The other requires the misspelling `showcase.restricted_opz`.
- Before: two toasts, one false (`restricted_ops`) and one real (the typo).
- After: one toast, the typo only.

**Fix** (`packages/app-shell/src/preview/capabilityLint.ts`): the pseudo-stack now carries `capabilities` read from `client.list('capability', {})`, unwrapped and stripped the same way as the permission rows. If that read fails, the list is empty, so the lint runs on the other sources and stays advisory.

## Tests

- New `capabilityLint.registryCapabilities-7611.test.ts` runs the real `validateCapabilityReferences`, not a stand-in. It has four cases: the registry serves the capability; the row comes in an `{ item }` envelope; a CONTROL where the registry is empty and both drafts warn; and a failed capability read, which still gives two warnings and does not throw.
- **Ablation:** with `capabilities,` removed from the stack, 2 of the 4 new tests fail (`Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`). Restoring gives blob `3a9ac204` = HEAD.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview packages/app-shell/src/utils/approverIdentity packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useApproverDirectory`: 34 files, 252 tests passed.

## Gates

`turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` (it builds the workspace dependencies first) passes: 30 of 30 tasks, exit 0.

`eslint` on the four touched source and test files: 0 errors. There are 7 `no-explicit-any` warnings, all on lines this diff does not change.

These checks all pass: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations).

## File surface

Everything is inside the claimed surface except two files, both declared here:
- `useApproverDirectory.ts`: comment-only, the same stale position wording as item 2.
- `content/docs/guide/console.md`: one sentence naming the sources the capability lint resolves against (AGENTS.md: docs-driven).

The branch is `claude/issue-7611-isolated-assign-reverify`. It is based on `main` `2c4e5f5`, and `main` has not moved since.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
